data.revised_prompt: Simple centered icon asset, bold silhouette, minimal detail, high contrast, readable at small sizes. Create a high-quality 3D chibi-style educational app avatar of a fictional Chinese schoolgirl, age 8–14, healthy, natural, friendly, clearly a student. Square 1:1. Front view or slight 3/4 view, tightly focused on the head. The full hair outline must be visible; face and hair together occupy 75%–85% of the frame. Only a tiny bit of shoulder and neck is visible at the bottom, with a small white school lapel/collar only; no emblem, no text. Not a half-body portrait. Distinct features: side high ponytail, side-swept bangs, a small purple bow hair accessory, slightly mischievous one-corner smile, bright brown eyes. Soft studio lighting, delicate modeling, smooth materials, matching a polished AI homeroom assistant / principal assistant style but clearly a student. Background: solid low-saturation lemon yellow filling the entire square edge-to-edge, no borders, no transparency, no frame, no ring, no halo, no scene. Emphasize clear hairstyle, expression, and accessory readability at small sizes. Avoid: half body, upper body, full body, hands, props, teacher, adult, headset, suit, heavy makeup, jewelry, top cropping, hair cropping, chin cropping, tiny face, large shoulders, white background, white border, transparent background, circular background, avatar frame, ring, halo, complex scene, text, letters, numbers, school badge, logo, watermark, multiple characters, real photo, flat 2D illustration, baby proportions, dark tone, low resolution, distorted facial features.
